title: Hash Brown Gyoza
description: A Japanese twist on traditional gyoza, with crispy hash brown crust and savory fillings.
instructions: Combine grated potatoes and hash in a bowl.
Add yellowed soy sauce and mix well.
Place a spoonful of the mixture onto a gyoza wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press edges to seal.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook the gyoza until golden brown on the bottom.
Flip the gyoza over and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
